Weakening facts: Art. 9 allows a simple ledger for brokers and cooperatives, so a paper ledger complies; Art. 13 accepts existing books or e-systems; Art. 21 has no fine amounts; the 2026 inspection plans found target registered grain firms rather than brokers. result.reason: I found no product, free state tool or exemption that kills the idea. Demand still looks thin. Art. 9 of 国粮粮规〔2025〕437号 lets brokers and cooperatives keep ledgers "简便易行", so a paper notebook with five fields complies. Art. 13 says existing accounting books or e-systems also satisfy it. Art. 21 sets no fine amounts. The 2026 inspection plans I found (Xinyang, Jiyuan in Henan) target firms in the grain statistics system (涉粮入统企业) and purchasing firms, not village brokers. Provinces set the reporting channels themselves (Art. 16), which could later become a free state tool. The search engine indexed almost no Chinese mini-programmes or app-store pages, so "no competitor" is unverified rather than confirmed. Generic Chinese weighing/purchase bookkeeping apps likely exist but weren't reached.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Strongest deadline find: SAT announcement requires all retail fuel stations to run 'transaction-as-invoice' (交易即开票) by 2026-11-01, via 乐企自用 or 乐企联用 platforms; small stations may use a shared-use platform. Joint opinion on dispenser-cheating control also stresses purchase/sales ledgers. LPG: national standard for traceability QR codes on gas cylinders in force since 2025-06-01 (over 10,000 fillers); local rules (Chongqing 2024) require filling-traceability systems and cylinder files. No small LPG dealer-level workflow tool found.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: New 粮食经营台账管理办法 (国粮粮规〔2025〕437号, issued 2025-12-31, effective 2026-04-01) obliges grain buyers, storers, processors, sellers and feed/industrial users to keep ledgers (3-year retention) and report basic data; simplified ledger for grain brokers and cooperatives. No ledger software or mini-programme found. Coffee/cocoa not screened separately (not a major Chinese regulated trade).

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Farmer cooperatives must file annual report 1 Jan-30 Jun on the national credit publicity system (measures amended 2025-03-18 and 2025-11-21); two years without reporting or operating leads to listing and licence revocation (Cooperative Law art. 71), with local mass clean-ups in 2025. Rural credit cooperatives are financial-regulator territory: nothing found.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: NHSA first-half 2026: 330k on-site inspections, 163.5bn RMB... (stated as 16.35 billion yuan recovered per source: 163.5亿元), five-year inspection plan 2026-2030 aims for full on-site coverage of designated providers; traceability code scanning required from 2025-07-01 for insurance settlement. No clinic-specific tool or rule found beyond that; software vendors for dental clinics exist (睿齿云, 牙医管家).

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Pharmacies: drug traceability code scan-and-upload for all drugs from 2026-01-01 (except decoction pieces/granules), codes on receipts; NMPA announcement 2026-09-01 extends full-chain traceability duties; reported coverage 530k pharmacies (79%); small pharmacies and village clinics weak on IT; NHSA to open a free three-code mapping library. Precursors: standard 易制毒 regime (sales ledger 2 years, class-1 sales reported within 5 days); nothing new found.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Only low-reliability sources on a Labour Dispatch Provisional Rules revision (claimed 10% cap, claimed effective 2025-04-01, not verified in official text). No security/cleaning-agency filing duty found. Nothing usable.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Real-name labour registration and wage special accounts are state-platform-driven (Shanghai V3.0 account application online from 2025-12-26; Fujian lets projects under 4m RMB use a mini-programme and skip the special account). Duties sit on main contractors and are served by state platforms; nothing new for small firms.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: New 《房地产从业机构反洗钱工作管理办法》 (MOHURD + PBOC) in force 2025-09-01: developers and brokerages must identify customers, file suspicious-transaction reports to CAMLMAC, keep records at least 10 years. No vendor of AML software for agencies found (Baidu check). Notary/lawyer AML not screened.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K09. Police guest-registration system is mandatory (特种行业许可证, ID verification devices, local minsu rules in Chaozhou, Shantou, Nan'an 2025); from 2026-03-20 foreigners can register online in seven provinces for non-hotel lodging.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Export aquaculture raw-material farms must file with customs (individuals, cooperatives, enterprises may apply); GACC amended foreign-facility registration rules (Order 280) from 2026-06-01 are import-side (foreign exporters, out of scope). Timber and forest-risk: no China-specific small-firm filing found in one search.

coverage.category: 31. Hazardous waste generators (small garages, labs, clinics): management plan, manifests, ledgers
coverage.found: Generators are tiered (key/simplified/registration management, HJ 1259-2022) and declare via the national solid-waste system; small-and-micro hazardous waste collection pilot extended to 2026-12-31 (MEE reply Dec 2025), collectors encouraged to offer plan, ledger, declaration and QR label services for generators under 10 t/year.

coverage.category: 32. Motor vehicle repair shops: electronic health record upload and filing
coverage.found: Transport ministry notice (2022) requires class-1/2 repairers to upload repair electronic records and class-3 data to be collected; local systems (Beijing annual re-filing by 1 Feb) exist. 修连邦 (Guangdong 修炼科技) is a shop system built to upload automatically and is free in the regions it runs in.

coverage.category: 33. Employers with occupational hazards (small factories): hazard declaration, testing, health checks
coverage.found: Hazard declaration to the national NHC system is a legal duty, renewed annually; 2022-2025 campaign targets 100% declaration/testing/checks for supported small and micro firms by end 2025; firms with under 10 workers left to provinces. No software or service found.

coverage.category: 34. Restaurants: used cooking oil and food-waste handover manifests
coverage.found: Local rules only (Shanghai handover manifest, Sanmenxia measures effective 2026-02-01, Beijing draft 2026); no national small-restaurant tool or filing.

coverage.category: 35. Small premises fire safety ('nine small premises'): maintenance, inspection and shared fire control rooms
coverage.found: 2026 State Council opinion on grassroots fire safety pushes unit self-management, risk-based and non-site supervision, and government-bought shared fire control rooms for nine-small premises; local campaigns run to mid/end 2026. No annual-report or filing duty found, so mainly government-driven.

coverage.found: Commerce ministry industry standards SB/T 10391/10392-2026 for liquor wholesale/retail in force 2026-07-01 (traceable purchase ledger 3 years, separate storage, staff training). They are recommended standards, not enforceable penalties. Tobacco licence regime unchanged.

coverage.category: 37. Dental and small clinics: radiation licence, personal dose records, medical waste
coverage.found: Dental clinics with class-III X-ray devices need a radiation safety licence from the environment bureau (Xuchang 2026 approval example) plus radiological diagnosis licence; inspections flag dose-record gaps. Medical waste ledger rules not found.

result.competitor: Free state tool: the national solid-waste information system has a built-in electronic ledger that auto-generates the declaration. Provincial systems also exist; Shanghai is upgrading its system in 2026 with 'one code' tracing. Commercial apps: 易企环 (iOS; automatic hazardous-waste e-ledger and inspections), 广西危废管家 (Guangxi; made by a recycling collector), 危废标识管理 (Shanghai 道臻; QR labels to HJ1276-2022). Collection units also bundle the paperwork as a service, and the HJ1259 guide names them for this role. No small-producer plan or declaration SaaS sold to collectors was found, but collectors appear to build their own tools.
result.duty: Real and in force. HJ1259-2022, MEE technical guide in force since 2022-10-01: producers keep a management plan and ledger and declare through the national solid-waste information system. Firms with an e-ledger in that system confirm an auto-generated declaration. Chongqing deadline: declare by end of March each year. The small-producer collection pilot was extended to 2026-12-31 by an MEE letter to Jiangxi dated 2025-12-31. That letter continues the pilot into the 15th Five-Year Plan but says new national policy will replace it, so nothing is confirmed after 2026. The 2023 pilot notice tells collectors to focus on firms producing under 10 t a year. Penalty amounts under the Solid Waste Law were not checked this session.
result.market: No national count found. Each province sets the number of collection units; Guizhou's draft caps it at roughly one per county, so collectors probably number in the hundreds to low thousands nationally. That estimate is unverified. The number of small producers under 10 t a year (auto repair shops, labs, workshops) is likely very large, but no register figure was found.
result.reason: The duty is real, but free and existing tools already do the core job. Under the MEE technical guide HJ1259-2022, producers are tiered as key, simplified or registration-managed, and must keep a management plan and a ledger. If a firm keeps its electronic ledger in the free national solid-waste information system, the system generates the annual declaration and the firm only confirms it. The guide also names small-producer collection units as the providers of plan, ledger and declaration services. Commercial apps already exist: 易企环 (automatic e-ledger), 广西危废管家 (built by a collector) and 危废标识管理 (QR labels to HJ1276-2022). The pilot is extended only to 2026-12-31, by a letter to Jiangxi province, and nothing beyond 2027 was found. Collectors are few, at most about one per county, and tend to build their own tools. Penalty amounts were not checked.

result.competitor: No Chinese ledger app or mini-programme aimed at brokers was found. Searches covered '粮食经营台账 小程序/系统/软件' and '收粮 记账 APP 粮食经纪人'; the specific product names I guessed (收粮宝, 粮掌柜) turned up nothing. Results were mostly US grain co-op apps. These remain unverified: provincial grain-bureau reporting systems that Art. 16 asks provinces to build, generic weighbridge (磅单) software, and generic bookkeeping apps that could already cover the five simple-ledger fields. The barrier to entry is low.
result.duty: Confirmed from the official text (gov.cn gazette). In force since 2026-04-01, valid for 5 years. Ledgers are built from purchase code slips, invoices and warehouse vouchers, in date order. Brokers and cooperatives may use a simple form with date, variety, quantity, amount and unit (Art. 9). Records are kept at least 3 years (Art. 12). Electronic ledgers are encouraged and count as the ledger (Art. 13). Operators must report basic purchase, storage and sale data (Art. 14), with the format and frequency left to provinces (Arts. 10 and 16), so no national frequency is set. Art. 21 only says violations are 'handled according to law', with no amounts. The penalty basis is the Grain Circulation Regulation art. 45(5). A Beijing discretion standard (draft for comment) allows no penalty for minor offences that are promptly corrected. Commentary (bjnews) shows tax invoicing is a bigger pain point for brokers.
result.market: I found no official count. A 2022 media report (huxiu), citing an incomplete count, says there are over 1 million grain brokers handling 70-80% of purchases. Registered purchasing firms and individual businesses number in the tens per county; Liyang in 2015 had 63, of which 39 were individual businesses. There is no national registration figure.
result.reason: The duty is real. The 粮食经营台账管理办法 (国粮粮规〔2025〕437号) has applied since 2026-04-01 for five years. It covers grain buyers, storers, processors and sellers, plus feed and industrial grain firms. Brokers and cooperatives may keep a simple ledger (Art. 9) and must keep records for at least 3 years. Electronic systems count as the ledger (Art. 13). Operators must report data (Art. 14), but provinces set the format and frequency. Art. 21 names no fine; the fallback is the Grain Circulation Regulation, and first minor offences may go unpunished. I found no Chinese ledger app aimed at brokers. Weak points: brokers are scattered, many are unregistered, they are used to no books and probably pay little, enforcement is soft, and provinces may build their own systems.

result.duty: Under Decree 810 (in force since 2025-06-20) and SAT Ann. 2025 No.15, platforms report operators' identity and income in the month after each quarter ends. Income is net of refunds but includes invoiced and uninvoiced sales and is not reduced by platform fees or commissions. Tax offices routinely compare this with operators' own filings and send SMS reminders when the gap is large (Xinhua, Science and Technology Daily, July 2026; system running one year by June 2026). Operators must export every platform and payment-channel statement and reconcile them. They then either file a correction and pay back tax plus late fees, or explain to the tax office with transaction and bank records. Evasion penalty is 50% to 5x the unpaid tax plus 0.05% per day. Platforms that fail to report face fines of CNY 20,000-100,000. The seller's duty is general (accurate declaration) and is triggered by a reminder, not a fixed recurring filing.
result.market: More than 7,000 platforms (SAT, Nov 2025), later reported as about 9,700, file these reports. Data on sellers is incomplete: the number of individual businesses trading on platforms grew 14.7% year on year, but no absolute figure was found. Total individual businesses are roughly 128 million (my estimate from SAMR's ratio). Natural-person online shops are exempt from registration under the 2025 standard. The number of operators who received reminders was not published.
result.reason: The duty is real and in force. State Council Decree 810 has applied since 2025-06-20, with SAT Announcement 2025 No.15. Platforms report each seller's gross income every quarter, and tax offices compare it with what sellers declared, sending SMS reminders when the gap is large. Sellers must check their figures and either correct the filing (back tax, 0.05%/day late fee, 50%-5x penalty for evasion) or explain it with evidence. I found no product that compares platform-reported income with declared income; e-commerce ERPs and SME tax-software vendors showed nothing. Score stays low: most sellers owe little or no tax, the job is triggered by a reminder rather than routine, bookkeeping agencies can absorb it, and the earlier K04 licensing and access objection is still unchecked.

The duty is real. MARA notice 农办牧〔2025〕20号 (2025-06-26) requires the new e-licence from 2025-09-01, filing of employed licensed vets, prescriptions kept per the 兽医处方格式及应用规范, and annual reports. But the licence number and QR code are issued by the state platform (兽医卫生综合信息平台), and the notice names no annual-report portal or deadline. Vet filing is done in the state system, so a vendor adds little. Clinic apps such as 它它医生 already cover prescriptions. Market is about 22k filed clinics (2024) or 34k by map count, mostly small, but the duties are light, one-off or state-portal based, and not a recurring paid pain. Weak software wedge; the case would rest on bundling with clinic management.

Duty is real: provincial rules (Fujian, Guizhou, Anhui) require filing with the county health authority through the online filing system. Changes to head, service form or places need a change filing, and relocation needs a new filing. The 2025-2027 action raises filing rates, and the national figure is 126k centres and 6.66m places at end-2025. But filing is one-off plus occasional changes, not recurring. It is done in the free state system, with few documents and no per-period cycle. No annual-report duty was found. Pain and frequency are low, and a Draft Childcare Services Law may change the basis. No filing-specific software was found, and 校轻松 is a general management SaaS. Willingness to pay is low and a tracker is a thin product.

result.reason: The Feb 2026 Shanghai Gold Jewellery Association letter is advisory only. It follows a prosecutor's recommendation and tells firms to follow DB31/T1262-2020. It is not a binding rule. I found an older, 2011 Shanghai police notice that requires ID-based registration for precious-metal purchases and a 30-day record, but I did not open it and could not confirm it is still in force. I found no dedicated competitor product, but the search was shallow. The market is small: local, mostly Shanghai, with no register count found. Software is easy to build, but willingness to pay is low and a PC or ID-reader integration is likely enough. Weak, regional, unclear enforcement. A search summary on the 2011 notice gave no hard penalty.

The duty is real. Yunnan Dept of Agriculture issued 云农规〔2025〕4号 on 2025-12-26 (title confirmed by search; the formal title drops "定点"). It covers small sites in remote areas (80+ km or 120+ min from the county seat) that supply only the local market. The national Pig Slaughter Regulation and the 2019 MARA notice back it, including county-level "only decrease, not increase". I could not read the PDF (compressed, unreadable by fetch), so penalties, licence term, record rules and effective date are unconfirmed. I found no site count and no competitor search result for this niche. The market is tiny and shrinking, with capped, government-designated sites. Buyers are low-digital and often offline. Willingness to pay is weak. Better as a free template than a product.

The duty is real and in force: SAMR Order No. 81 (the Measures on quality and safety supervision of edible-farm-product sales in markets) took effect 2023-12-01. It requires operators to keep seller files, check purchase vouchers and 承诺达标合格证 per batch, and sample-test products without papers. Sellers keep purchase ledgers for at least 6 months. 2026 enforcement is confirmed, e.g. a Fengtai (Beijing) warning and a Shehong (Sichuan) fine of 1,000 yuan. I found no named commercial competitor, but my searches were thin. Local smart-market standards (Jiangsu, Shenzhen) and city traceability or e-certificate systems (Yinchuan) are government-driven and often free. Demand is mostly municipal procurement, so a solo founder is unlikely to sell to many small operators. Sellers are tiny stall holders with low willingness to pay. I did not find a market count. Score stays at 3.

Duty is real: SAT announcement (June 2026) requires all retail fuel stations to run 交易即开票 via the 乐企 platform by 2026-11-01. The SAT interpretation says stations choose 乐企自用 or 乐企联用, and cash or card sales may need manual payment entry. Penalty: correction order, fines up to 1万元 for evasion such as non-own payment codes, plus tax recovery for evasion. Market is about 110k stations, nearly half private. Competition: vendors already sell one-stop 乐企联用 filing for small stations, and one claims 10,000+ stations served. They rely on existing 乐企联用 qualifications, which a solo or foreign founder would lack. It is a one-off deadline about 3 weeks away, and it needs dispenser integration. Approved-platform list and foreign-founder eligibility were not found.

The duty is real. A four-department NHSA notice (March 2025) requires scan-before-settlement from 2025-07-01 and full-volume code collection and upload from 2026-01-01. Retail receipts must show the codes. The duty falls on all insured (定点) pharmacies and clinics. Penalty and frequency were not confirmed: it is a continuous per-sale duty, and the penalty is presumably loss of insurance settlement, which I did not verify. Competition was not resolved: my searches found no named vendor, but they returned only policy articles. Integration runs through the existing two-designated-institution (两定) HIS/POS vendors, and the state offers free mapping and identification libraries. Reported 98% of insured retail pharmacies were already connected by March 2025. That points to a crowded, vendor-bundled market, with low willingness to pay and a gap that is closing. The village clinic count was not found. The NMPA 2026-09-01 item was not opened.

The duty is real. The MOHURD/PBOC measures have applied since 2025-09-01 to developers and brokerages that sell or broker home sales. They require customer ID checks, refusing unidentified clients, suspicious-transaction reports to the CAMLMAC, 10-year record retention, an AML officer or unit, risk assessment, training, and audit. Penalties come under Art. 58 of the AML Law (the amount was not checked). The measures set no large-transaction report and no fixed frequency; the duty is event-driven. I found no local vendor or free state tool, but only two searches targeted this, and the results were foreign vendors. Beike and similar platforms were not checked. Weaknesses: the duty is soft and enforcement is unproven; filing depends on a CAMLMAC channel and credentials not verified; the brokerage market is shrinking; and the buyers are fragmented, low-margin and unlikely to pay. Brokerage count not found.

The duty is real. Under the Farmer Cooperative Annual Report Disclosure Measures (amended 2025-11-21, SAMR Order 108), cooperatives must file on the national credit publicity system from 1 Jan to 30 Jun. Late filers go on the abnormal-operations list within 10 working days. Under Cooperative Law art. 71, two years without operating can lead to licence revocation. Market: about 2.94 million cooperatives at 2025-06-30 (people's CPPCC news), many dormant. Competition: filing is free and online, and I found no dedicated software. I found no fee data for local agents (unverified). Weak points: low willingness to pay, a fragmented rural buyer base, and dormant cooperatives that simply stop filing. Done-for-you deregistration is a local service business, not scalable software.
